info.title: Manager NAV / Net PnL / Return series

get.description: Exact-decimal NAV / Net PnL / Return series for 1-4 subjects (portfolios or the fund) over one exact window. Each subject is AVAILABLE, EMPTY or typed UNAVAILABLE; nothing is rebased, summed across currencies, interpolated or carried forward. `comparison` is re-derived by the validator and is INCOMPARABLE (CURRENCY_MIXED, ...) when the subjects do not share one partition, basis, unit, methodology and window. The financial normalized source that fills a series is MISSING today: every profile answers SERIES_SOURCE_NOT_PUBLISHED until a producer publishes one.

200.description: Authorized current series answer; absence stays typed

400.description: Invalid closed query (as_of_ms is refused as CURRENT_ONLY)

503.description: Source publication or bounded capability unavailable

message.const: The requested Execution read is not available.
